limits: Real long-path error toast desktop/phone. Chat/user messages, corrective nudges and other toast branches are compiler/unit/source-only; no model execution.

Real Local standalone Canvas, installed Chrome, unmodified control-openhands, pinned SDK1.60.1 and default theme. Other themes, Cloud/ACP, planning/delegated and embedded modes are source/compiler/unit-only.

No model/profile/provider-credential setup or execution. Wrapping uses a deliberately nonexistent local path rejected by the real backend400; no app is installed. Motion types into a form that is never submitted.

Original screenshots and complete sampled native clips are unchanged. Film adds clear labels and very quiet original ambience. Sampled recordings show trigger/transition/final states but do not prove exact wall-clock durations.
The initial baseline motion attempt missed the collapsed rail hover gate. That incomplete clip is excluded; both sides use the same corrected complete hover interaction.
Toast viewport rectangles were sampled during the existing entrance animation and are retained as observations, not settled-bounds equivalence proof. Computed text layout and scroll dimensions match.

CSS comparison normalizes insignificant whitespace, animation shorthand token order and numeric opacity spelling; transition property lists, importance, media, duration/easing fallbacks and pulse keyframes match.
